quantification_rationale: Operational metrics quantified (Scope 1+2 80% reduction, 49% renewables, 71% waste/paper reduction). However, the SASB FN-CB-550a metrics (G-SIB score, CET1, leverage ratio, LCR/NSFR, stress test scenario outputs) are NOT in retrieved evidence.
